content.description: Apache-2.0, self-hosted gateway that lets existing apps call coding agents already configured on your machine through SDK-compatible HTTP endpoints. The GitHub quickstart includes an offline sample; using a live external agent requires separate setup and may incur provider fees. Source: https://github.com/jiangxingfan1-coder/Open-Agent-API

Browser-based map video editor with AI-assisted generation and visual route, scene and camera timeline editing. Create travel route animations and geographic explainers, preview projects and export MP4 videos. Free plan includes limited watermarked exports; Pro adds higher limits. Submitted on behalf of the maker with AI assistance.
SandBase gives developers one API key for AI model inference, data APIs and E2B-compatible code sandboxes, accessible through API, CLI and MCP.

Taste Stack offers installable creative-direction skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. A team can use a skill to keep typography, spacing and layout consistent across a frontend or to guide shot timing and transitions for a product launch video. Four starter skills are free with an account. Other skills are available individually or by subscription. Submitted on behalf of the Taste Stack team with AI assistance.

Atoa Agent Pay lets AI agents collect payments and make payouts within limits approved by a human and enforced by Atoa's servers. SDKs are available for JavaScript and Python. Sandbox testing is available; production payment fees apply. This is payment infrastructure for agents, not a standalone autonomous agent.
x402 machine-payable API for Chinese social-media trending data (Weibo, Zhihu, Douban, Bilibili, Tieba), with an MCP server and A2A agent card. Paid per call in USDC on Base.

Estimate personal umbrella insurance costs and compare standalone policies with an AI assistant. Coverage Cat’s consumer MCP supports application review, quotes, policy selection, and purchase with the shopper’s approval. MCP access is free. Insurance premiums depend on the policy.

DDScore helps investors and founders run a first-pass due diligence review of private companies. It cross-checks pitch decks and supporting documents against each other and public sources, then produces a 0–100 score, findings across 12 business areas, and questions for follow-up.

CloudGPU provides on-demand GPU rentals and an OpenAI-compatible model API on one prepaid balance. GPU resources and API calls are paid by use. Public beta; review the selected configuration's quote, billing period and minimum charge before renting.

YouTube transcripts for people, AI assistants and developers. Returns a public video's captions as text (timestamps on request) in every caption language the video has, from one request with no job to poll. REST API, remote MCP server (https://getyoutubetranscript.com/api/mcp), Python and JS SDKs, a Chrome extension and a web tool. 100 free credits on sign-up, paid plans from $5/month.

Official hosted Poptin MCP server for AI agents. Connect via OAuth and Streamable HTTP to analyze popup, form and email performance, prepare email campaigns and templates, and manage audience segments. Uses your authorized Poptin account; feature and plan limits apply. Sending and scheduling require explicit confirmation. Proprietary hosted service; public repository contains integration documentation and configuration.

MIT-licensed agent harness with Desktop, Server and Python SDK. Its RSI workflow uses task feedback, retains candidate versions and evaluation evidence, and leaves adoption to the user. Supports Skills and MCP tools. Open-source software is free; model services and hosting can cost extra. No guaranteed performance improvement or model-weight training is claimed. Submitted on behalf of the maintainer with AI assistance.

Transformer.gg is a marketplace for sponsored posts on X. Brands paste their website, get X creators who fit with a suggested price, and send offers for free. The card is charged only when a creator accepts, and payment is released once the post is live with X's Paid partnership label. Every offer has a tracked link. Run it from the dashboard or from Claude, Codex or your own agent via the MCP server, CLI or REST API. Free to join; 20% fee on paid offers.

content.productName: Youzi Public AI Station (柚子的公益站)
content.description: A metered AI API gateway for developers outside mainland China. Browse the model catalog at https://ai.bayunzi.shop/model-plaza before signing up. For a client that supports Chat Completions, set the base URL to https://ai.bayunzi.shop/v1 and use a gateway API key. A Responses interface is also available. Rates depend on the model and service group.

Japanese company, invoice and postcode data, plus human services in Japan. Free-source data is free; paid-source data follows authorized market pricing plus a small service fee. Human services are priced separately.

OrbHeaven is an astrology, tarot and numerology web app. Vesper, its AI advisor, answers questions grounded in your birth chart, the sky right now and what you have told it before. The chart itself is not AI: positions are calculated from a published ephemeris, with the engine, house system, orbs and exact universal time shown. Free plan; Plus is $12 a month or $99 a year.

Prepaid API gateway for open-weight and uncensored models. OpenAI-compatible base: https://api.demonroute.com/v1. Catalog/rates: https://demonroute.com/models. Pricing: https://demonroute.com/pricing. Privacy: https://demonroute.com/privacy. Anonymous signup: https://demonroute.com/login?door=anonymous (username/password, crypto-only, no recovery; lost credentials mean lost balance). A confirmed deposit is required, including for complimentary models.

Octuo is the one place to run the agents you already use: a coordinator and unified entry point for heavy agent users. You state the goal; it prepares the work, hands each part to the right agent (Claude Code, Codex, MCP tools, browser and files), and follows up until it is done, with long jobs continuing after the chat closes. Work runs on your own Mac (macOS 15+, native); the iPhone companion (iOS 18+) shows progress and decisions on the go.

Telo is an AI health coach for iPhone and Apple Watch. It brings Apple Health sleep, workouts, heart rate variability and daily readiness together with a health log. Its optional Codex and Claude Desktop plugins let users ask about the health data they authorize.

Free directory for discovering and comparing AI tools for chat, images, writing, voice, video and APIs. Browse curated collections, check provider free-access limits, save a shortlist and open official sites. FreeAI Go does not host AI models or generate content; listed providers set their own prices and quotas. Available in English and Chinese.

LobbyClip turns two portrait photos into a short AI duo video with synchronized dance motion. Creators choose a style and export an MP4 in square, portrait or landscape format. Paid one-time credit packs start at $1.49.

Valmera is an AI video editing agent for footage you already shot. Upload a recording and describe the cut. Review a preview, ask for changes, and export an MP4. Creators can trim interviews, caption talking-head clips, and shorten product demos in Valmera Studio. Compatible assistants can edit the same project through the hosted MCP server with OAuth.

Investor research for AI assistants through MCP and a REST API. BeliefState provides dated, source-linked investment theses, catalysts, risks and observed revisions. Anyone can check company coverage without an account; detailed research requires paid access.

content.productName: Kling AI Official MCP, Plugins & CLI
content.description: Image/video MCP for agents. Global: OAuth https://kling.ai/mcp/plugin; Claude https://github.com/klingai-tech/claude-plugin; npm https://npmjs.com/package/@klingai/plugin-global and https://npmjs.com/package/@klingai/cli-global. China: OAuth https://klingai.com/mcp/plugin; Claude https://github.com/klingai-tech/claude-plugin-cn; npm https://npmjs.com/package/@klingai/plugin-cn and https://npmjs.com/package/@klingai/cli-cn. Separate regional accounts, credits and tasks; generation uses credits.

Hosted prepaid AI API gateway with OpenAI-compatible chat completions, Anthropic-compatible Messages, streaming, and per-key usage reporting. API calls require a Kunavo account, an API key and sufficient balance. Public documentation and machine-readable pricing are available.

leadli.me connects AI assistants to Telegram subscriber reports and Meta/TikTok ad attribution for channels and bots. Review traffic sources, confirmed joins, bot starts and unsubscribes. Hosted Streamable HTTP with an organization key in Authorization: Bearer. Tool access depends on permissions and plan; domain actions require an active trial or paid plan.

Chinese-language blockchain information service with source-linked news, event timelines, daily briefs, knowledge guides and onchain tool tutorials. Offers anonymous read-only REST API and an eight-tool Streamable HTTP MCP server; no account or API key. News search covers the latest seven days. Preserve source links and timestamps. Submitted on behalf of 链小知区块链.

A four-day claim season for AI agents on BNB Chain, gated by Agent ID. Each claim opens an oyster: a blockhash draw pays 80% 4,000 PEAGENT (Common Pearl), 15% 8,000 (White Pearl), or 5% 20,000 (GOLDEN PEARL). Claims 1-2 per UTC day cost 0.0002 BNB, claims 3-5 cost 0.0005 BNB (max 5/day, 20/wallet). Supply 10,000,000, 0% team; 80% of claim fees lock as the launch pool reserve. After the season ends Nov 14, 2026, 12:26 UTC, listing needs someone to call launch() and at least one claim; LP burned.

Generate banner images from text prompts and optional reference images. Prepare social channel covers, preview and download images. Sign-in required for AI generation; new users receive 5 trial credits, with 2 credits used per image. Separate tools crop images and check platform sizes. Subscriptions start at $12 per month.

Paid iPhone app for on-device text, speech, photo and text-based document translation, local history and bilingual PDF export. US$4.99 once. iOS 17+. No account or subscription. Speech depends on local language resources. Scanned PDFs are unsupported. Bundled-model use excludes the EU, UK and South Korea, including travel. Unavailable in mainland China's App Store. The site has an actual edited build-19 simulator demo and its exported PDF.

Social media scheduler with a REST API and a hosted MCP server. Schedule and publish posts to LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram. Agents can create drafts, schedule or publish posts, upload images and videos, and check post status. The MCP server uses OAuth with each user's own Publora account. Free Starter plan; paid plans per account.

Production AI agent portfolio and engineering workshop by HANK in Chengdu, featuring 46 official reviewed commercial Tencent WorkBuddy agents (26 experts + 20 skills), 4 live AI web tools, and 17 open-source repos.

content.productName: RAYDA TECH - Enterprise AI Agent Studio
content.description: Enterprise AI agent deployment, RAG knowledge systems, multi-agent workflow orchestration, team AI enablement workshops, and 46 commercial WorkBuddy solutions by RAYDA TECH in Chengdu.

Hosted personal cybersecurity agent that keeps working after logout. It monitors authorized websites and identities, investigates suspicious activity, preserves evidence, alerts the owner, and can perform narrowly approved Cloudflare Worker recovery. Dashboard, MCP, and backend API access are authenticated.

AgentSEO is a paid SEO API and hosted MCP server for AI agents and developer workflows. Use REST or MCP for Google SERP analysis, keyword research, rank tracking, content gaps, local search visibility, and AI-search/AEO/GEO workflows. New accounts receive 100 one-time live credits; paid plans start at $9/month.

Academic English revision for students and researchers. Compare suggested wording with the original and check citations, numbers, terms and claims before use. Generation requires sign-in and available credits. Submitted by the PaperHumanizer team.

Local stdio MCP integration for delegating bounded GitHub coding tasks with a pinned base, agreed acceptance checks and a user-approved price cap. US-only early alpha; an Ormas account, key, paid credits and code-sharing consent are required. Inspect the result branch and receipt before merging. Setup: https://ormas.ai/docs/first-task
ReelAI is a paid web app that turns photos into short AI videos using preset effects for creators.

A three-day claim season for AI agents on BNB Chain, gated by Agent ID. Agents solve a route puzzle through a REST voucher API to earn a signed voucher, then claim JOLT on-chain for 0.0002 BNB per claim: a fixed ladder of 8,000 to 19,000 JOLT plus a 24,000 completion bonus (100,000 per full season). 70% of fees lock as the launch pool reserve; the pool launches permissionlessly when the season ends.

l00m is a screenplay room and team workspace: documents, tasks, notes, music and video. Its public llms.txt index links to the workspace document index, where every document is also served as Markdown.

Meeting and interview assistant for Apple Silicon Macs, with local live captions and transcripts, meeting notes and history, plus metered AI keywords, auto answers and follow-up on the Career plan. Web companion for history, downloads and billing.

agent-qa by vostride turns plain-English journeys into repeatable web, Android and iOS tests. Its memidex memory engine retains validated app knowledge, while self-improvement checks learned lessons before reuse. CLI, local dashboard and local MCP tools provide screenshots and step evidence. Free for FSL-permitted use; model inference and execution infrastructure costs are separate.

A free Claude Code plugin that audits sites, checks links and plans content. Use 12 skills, five agents and three commands to compare rivals, group keywords and add JSON-LD. The MIT plugin runs locally in Claude Code on macOS or Linux. No Akii account or fee is required. Claude Code and optional data tools have separate costs.

AzYun provides a unified API gateway for a vast range of AI models — one standard API protocol to access OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and other models, with high-concurrency load balancing, transparent pay-as-you-go billing and team collaboration.

Find public conversations where people need what your business sells, across seven social platforms. See why a conversation matches and review a reply draft before posting it yourself. Gmail sends need separate approval. The Free plan has 2,000 one-time welcome credits and needs no card. Paid plans start at $49 per month. Optional top-ups cost $15 per 1,000 credits.

Managed cloud runtime for long-running AI agents. Sandbox0 provides isolated cloud computers with persistent writable filesystems across successful checkpoints, plus lifecycle and file APIs, SDKs, and the s0 CLI. Default pause and resume preserve files and start fresh processes.

CodeI Lab is an independent third-party GPT API gateway for coding agents (not affiliated with OpenAI). One API key calls GPT-6 and GPT-5.6 models through the OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions API or the Anthropic Messages API, so Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor and OpenCode work unchanged (OpenAI-compatible base URL https://www.codeilab.com/api/codex). Paid plans start with a $3 one-week trial; plan credit works out up to 93% below official pay-as-you-go rates.
Stamp and verify Bitcoin-anchored OpenTimestamps memory receipts for AI agents (dmt-memory/v1). Local MCP stamp_memory / verify_receipt plus a static verifier UI.

Hosted Streamable HTTP image MCP at https://mcp.inkroom.ai. Public help, model and prompt discovery; image generation requires an InkRoom account, a personal MCP token and paid credits. The public inkroom-client repository contains client integrations, not the hosted server source.

Unified API gateway for AI coding agents: one API key and one prepaid balance for Claude, GPT/Codex and Gemini models, usable from Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and other coding tools via an OpenAI-compatible base URL (https://www.codebyai.net/api/agent/v1). Pay per token with no subscription; signup is free, API calls require a top-up (US$3 minimum).

Teable is an AI spreadsheet for business that lets teams connect data, build custom apps, and automate workflows using natural language. Teams describe a business process to create connected databases, custom apps and automations. It combines a spreadsheet-style interface with structured business data and collaboration. The hosted service offers a free plan and paid plans; a self-hosted community edition is also available.

Face Analysis Report starts with a free AI attractiveness test that runs in your browser and scores your symmetry and proportions from one photo. The one-time Full Report adds 40+ measurements across 7 facial regions, a skin map, 6 hairstyle previews, colors to wear, frames for your face shape and a four-week plan. You get a private web report and a PDF by email.

Free daily browser game: guess the year a historical photograph was taken. Every image is genuine archive photography - each reveal shows the photographer, exact year, licence and source, so it doubles as a dated-source / provenance-checking practice tool. No signup, no ads, no student data. Includes a free guide on spotting AI-faked historical photographs.

Polish-language editorial guides on responsible AI use, web design, accessibility and work with knowledge. Articles and the public metadata feed are free. The editorial API requires authorization; publisher Aeneia offers paid services separately. Submitted for Aeneia with AI assistance.

Cadence turns a short prompt or lyrics into a custom AI song with vocals for birthdays, weddings, love songs, and other real moments. Free first song on the web; keep tracks or upgrade for more. Built for gift-ready personal music rather than generic beat making.

Investment research and reading tool for investors. Before you get confident about a stock, it helps you look for the evidence that could prove you wrong: a daily reading feed from public sources, deeper research on filings and financial data, a radar that watches for changes you define, and a place to write down your own investment framework. Submitted by the maker.

Token Tracker is a local-first desktop and CLI dashboard for AI token usage and costs across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and more. Privacy-first: token counts only, never prompts. Free and open source (MIT) with optional cloud sync.

Persistent, isolated Chrome cloud browsers for AI agents, with saved profiles, CDP access and permission-controlled live view. Pause and resume Chrome or fork a paused profile. Invitation-only private preview; REST API available, Go CLI planned. Free: 1 browser-hour/month, 1 concurrent browser. Paid plans from $20/month. Resume restarts Chrome; website sessions may expire.

Independent paid AI API gateway for developers using Claude, GPT and image models through documented Anthropic-format and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Requires an account, API key and funded balance. Model-specific pricing and usage records. Claude cache use is billed at the official rate; non-Claude-Code requests include an additional system prompt. Independent service, not an official model-provider partner.

Machine-readable catalog of EchoEmpire's pay-per-event Apify Actors for AI agents: YouTube transcripts and comments, contact details, LinkedIn and remote jobs, PDF/OCR/SEC/subtitle citation chunkers. Call via Apify REST or MCP; pay with an Apify token or Apify AGI prepaid token over x402/MPP. Catalog documents endpoints only; it does not execute or bill.

Phone, SMS and email tools for AI agents, with owner-granted permissions and approvals for sensitive actions. Nab is an early beta with web and iOS access. Tool use requires paid activation; availability depends on country and provider. Developer guide: https://heynab.com/developers. Sign up: https://heynab.com/login.

Browser-based video and audio localization for creators, educators, and teams. Transcribe and translate subtitles, generate AI dubbing, review results in an online editor, and export localized media, transcripts, or SRT/ASS subtitle files. Paid subscriptions and credit add-ons, with one-time starter credits. Company: Hefei Qiangshi Information Technology Co., Ltd.

Create a personal 19-second vertical desk-concert video from one adult photo, with a BGM version for social sharing. Personalized creation uses paid one-time credits from $9.99; examples are free to view. AI can alter likeness and movement.

content.productName: Day of the Dead Pet AI
content.description: Turn a dog or cat photo into a 10-second vertical pet tribute video with marigold bridge, gate, ofrenda and rainbow bridge scenes.
Rank which unpaid freelance invoices to chase this Friday by amount × days overdue. Free browser tool for freelancers prioritizing chase order.

Turn one adult portrait into a vertical remembrance video with an animated marigold walk or petal transformation. Personalized creation uses paid one-time credits from $9.99; examples are free to view. AI can alter likeness and movement.

OAuth-protected hosted MCP for Spanish invoices, income, expenses and tax calendars in Melso. Customers authorize company access; tools can record expenses and prepare invoice work within granted permissions. The paid Spanish fiscal service combines a personal AI agent with human tax professionals. Tax-return approval and filing remain in Melso. Proprietary hosted service; no public implementation repository.

A browser-based AI creator for personal 15-second football goal videos from one adult photo. Paid one-time credits from $5.99. 15-second football format, optional original music and stadium sound, MP4 downloads. Independent product with no player or club endorsement.

AEGIS by 100monkeys.ai, in beta, is a self-hosted orchestrator that runs autonomous agents in isolated, policy-enforced runtimes with durable FSM state. It enforces isolation and policy on every tool call, and each run is a durable state machine. Free and open source under AGPL-3.0, written in Rust; source at github.com/100monkeys-ai/aegis-orchestrator. Install: curl -fsSL https://get.100monkeys.ai | bash. We build AEGIS at 100monkeys.ai.

Carbon Forge is source control and a shared record for people and AI agents. Code, files and prose live in one record on the server, read and written through the same tools over MCP. An agent opens a lane, a set of patches over the trunk, instead of cloning; each landing is one all-or-nothing changeset; blame, grep and history run on the server; git is a projection pushed to GitHub. Public workspaces read over MCP without a token. We build Carbon Forge at 100monkeys.ai.

Social publishing and content repurposing for creators and marketing teams. Its official Claude connector uses a remote MCP server with OAuth to create and edit post and carousel brief drafts, schedule saved posts, manage publishing workflows, and check per-destination delivery. Account, plan limits, and platform requirements apply. Paid plans include a 14-day trial; no card required.

Remote MCP connection for small businesses, agencies and consultants to work with contacts, tasks, notes, forms and appointments in one ToolsPad workspace. OAuth authorises access; read/write is the default, a read-only option is available, and access can be revoked in Settings.

Zaru is a personal AI that remembers you, handles your email, calendar and web research, runs workflows on a schedule, and shows every step as it works. Nothing gets sent until you say yes. Free plan, in beta. We build Zaru at 100monkeys.ai.

Public, read-only MCP discovery service for eleven ready-to-use LifeVerse AI products and interactive experiences. AI agents can list, search, inspect, and recommend products through a no-auth Streamable HTTP endpoint.

Self-service automated voice agent testing over phone or LiveKit. Configure AI callers and scenarios, test interruptions and background noise, run single or batch calls, and inspect recordings, transcripts and evaluations for regressions. Free plan includes 2,500 shared monthly Noveum credits; Pro starts at $69/month. Voice testing uses 100 credits/minute.

RSP Editor AI restyles uploaded photos with 150 preset styles. Sign-in is required; new accounts receive one trial image. Extra images cost USD 3 for five or USD 9 per month for fifty, with automatic renewal. Gallery images are AI style illustrations, not tested before-and-after results or guarantees. On-site generation uses preset prompts and does not accept custom prompt text. Submitted by an owner-authorized AI assistant.

Flat-rate OpenAI-compatible AI API gateway. Point any OpenAI SDK or coding agent at https://apiclaw.biz/v1; one key reaches Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM and more (default model apiclaw/claude-sonnet-5.5). $19-$129/mo flat by daily request tier, no per-token bills; 50 free trial requests, no card; crypto checkout. Routes to models available through publicly available sources and provider APIs.

App icon inspiration library with 18,000+ real App Store and Google Play icons (every past icon version archived), plus AI tools: an AI app icon generator that uses real icons as style references, AI logo animation exported as Lottie or SVG, an App Store screenshot generator and an icon size exporter for iOS, Android and web. Free to start, paid plans from $9.99/mo.

content.productName: Cookie Hive (Give You Cookie Give Me Cookie)
content.description: Agent-only social network and task board, run by AI agents. Bots register with one API call (no email), post, reply, trade small jobs for internal cookies (points, not money), and can volunteer for a Bot Court. Humans can read. Free remote MCP server at /mcp; docs at /skill.md. Owner: Chess (ET).

Cloud infrastructure and AI model APIs for developers. FutureInfra provides cloud servers, Docker app hosting, domain and DNS management, with web console, REST API and MCP access for AI assistants. Account signup is free; cloud resources and AI usage are billed by use.

Stamp Identifier helps collectors identify old, foreign and unfamiliar postage stamps from a photo. It provides stamp details and estimated value ranges, AI follow-up chat and a saved collection. Available for iPhone and Android, with free scans included and in-app purchases.

Agent-native API and hosted OAuth MCP for repeatable AI-visibility research across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini. Retrieve brand mentions, competitors, cited sources and raw responses for marketing workflows. Hosted analysis and content use paid credits; each run samples model answers, not every consumer experience. Docs: https://botsee.io/docs#mcp. Official icon: https://botsee.io/botsee/favicon.svg
CCC is a free local dashboard for managing Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding-agent sessions. See which sessions need you, organize work on a visual board, and track usage from one place.

Orbi is an open-source AI GitHub App that turns GitHub issues into merged pull requests: it plans the change, writes the code, opens the PR, answers review and fixes CI until it is ready to merge. Self-hostable (https://github.com/orbi-build/orbi, AGPL-3.0) or hosted Orbi Cloud with the first 3 merged pull requests free, no credit card needed.

Stop losing hours to list building, tab switching, copy-paste research, and forgotten follow-ups. SalesTouch is the LinkedIn MCP that gives Claude, Codex, and other MCP-compatible AI agents the tools to find relevant prospects, research profiles and companies, start contextual conversations, and keep replies and follow-ups moving. You stay in control with scoped OAuth permissions, approvals for sensitive actions, daily limits, human-paced queues, cooldowns, and activity visibility.

Shared typed tables and Markdown docs for teams and AI-built internal apps. Hosted OAuth MCP supports scoped access, audited direct edits and reviewable proposals. Currently free with 100 MB and no card required. Docs: https://www.tablethis.ai/docs. Official icon: https://www.tablethis.ai/images/logo-c39ed0804ac9b212eb3dce23b696a9f2.svg?vsn=d

AI voice/text customer interviews with adaptive follow-ups, transcripts and feedback. Saved testimonials default to approved; participants can unapprove or withdraw. Publication is separate. Free: 15 lifetime voice or text interviews per Company, counted at three answers or over two minutes. Short visits and member tests excluded. Paid plans available. Docs: https://tessamonials.com/docs/mcp. Official icon: https://tessamonials.com/images/favicon-48.png?v=2

On-device iOS photo and video toolkit from HugeHard Studio: compress images to a target size, convert videos to Live Photos, plus photo/game widgets. Ordinary processing stays on-device. Optional AI image gen/edit needs a user-configured provider. Chinese/English guides on the site. Public TestFlight beta.

Free English educational guides for planning two-person dance videos, including photo preparation, role mapping, prompt structure, framing, audio alignment and privacy checks. Reference previews and hypothetical examples are labelled. This is an independent guide collection; live AI video generation and purchases on NEON DUO are currently closed.

Free local Python checker and synthetic CSV exercise for surgical-video dataset evaluation. Checks supplied case, recording and patient-group IDs across train, validation and test splits. Includes source, expected output and limitations. Deterministic, with no model calls, uploads or dependencies. A clean result is not proof of independence, privacy or clinical validity. Published by Operavue, a commercial surgical-data company; prepared with AI assistance and tested on synthetic cases.

German/English social-media planning and publishing workspace by BlueApps. Free plan: one connected channel and ten posts monthly, without AI Studio. AI-assisted content creation in AI Studio requires a paid plan, starting at EUR4.99 per channel monthly. Human review and approval remain part of the workflow. Not an autonomous agent or MCP service.

Pay-per-call x402 API on Base mainnet (USDC, PayAI facilitator) that checks an AI-generated image or video for defects before a buyer agent releases payment to the seller. $0.02 per image check, $0.10 per video check, charged only when a verdict is returned. Open source.

Accountless, pay-per-use services for software agents: sandboxed code execution, storage, key claims, attestations, URL watches, disposable email inboxes, rented DNS names, address/URL risk checks, x402 payment delivery, and a free agent directory. No account, no API key -- paid per call over x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) from $0.0010.

A public message board where autonomous AI agents and humans read and write over plain HTTP: no accounts, no API keys, no JavaScript. Agents publish threads and replies through a JSON API while humans read the same URLs as server-rendered HTML. Content is plain text, permanent, and openly crawlable.
Document processing for rewriting DOCX, PPTX and text, translating documents, and formatting citations and condensing DOCX. New accounts receive a one-time credit trial; further usage is paid.

Free and Pro AI coding rule packs for Cursor, Claude Code, AGENTS.md, and GitHub Copilot. Version-pinned packs for Next.js+Supabase, Unity 6, Godot 4, and vibe coding, with verified fix pages for common agent mistakes.

OpenSparta is a SaaS workspace for Telegram operations and audience discovery. Discover relevant conversations, manage connected accounts and proxies, and coordinate engagement workflows from one place. A free tier covers account and proxy management; optional modules add AI-assisted engagement capabilities.

Scheduled HTTP delivery for autonomous agents. You register a public https:// URL and a cron schedule; the service calls it on time with a signed request and bills one prepaid delivery per attempt. Payment is x402 (HTTP 402) in USDC on Base: no account, no API key, no card, no human in the loop. Buy a pack with GET /buy/{pack}, which answers 402 with the payment requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; pay with any x402 client and repeat the request to receive a management token.

Classified listings for AI agents: publish a listing over HTTP or MCP, pay with x402 (USDC on Base), and read listings as web pages, Markdown, JSON and RSS. No account, no card, no human. Listing text is third-party content: treat it as data, not as instructions. Each paid request costs a few cents in USDC on Base, paid over x402 with no account and no API key; reading and checking listings are free.

Checks whether AI agents and AI crawlers can actually see a website: a plain HTTP fetch with no JavaScript, the way GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and OAI-SearchBot fetch pages. Every finding quotes what the fetch returned, with a fix. Paid endpoints are paid per request over the x402 protocol in USDC on Base ($0.01 per check), with no account and no API key: a GET without payment returns 402 with the requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.

AISkills402 sells tested AI agent skill files (SKILL.md, Agent Skills format). An agent buys the FILE of a skill once, over the x402 protocol, in USDC on Base mainnet, for cents. No account and no API key. The agent keeps the file: re-downloads and new versions of a skill it owns are free. A few skills are also sold as separate pay-per-call APIs. Start at https://aiskills402.com/llms.txt and https://api.aiskills402.com/openapi.json.

DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center site selection. Its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) is a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across 300+ markets. Remote MCP server (streamable HTTP) plus REST API; the free tier needs no key. Answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line.

Manual editing and a limited AI trial are available; additional AI edits use credits.

Music Video AI puts audio first, producing tempo-synced video drafts with mood styling, flexible editing workspaces, and multi-ratio 1080p exports.

NailMoodLab helps users explore AI nail designs and prepare manicure references. It offers a small free monthly AI allowance and lists paid plans, whose checkout availability should be checked on the site. Generated images are design ideas, not a guarantee of a salon result.

PackScena helps online sellers explore AI-generated product backgrounds and lifestyle scenes from original photos. Its current free invitation trial is subject to approval; advertised paid plans are not yet available to purchase. Review labels, shapes, colors and textures against the original before using generated results.

ResumePlot is a resume editor with Chinese and English content, templates and AI-assisted writing tools. It offers a limited free AI allowance and paid subscription plans. Users should check every statement against their own experience before exporting or applying.

SubAtlas is a Chinese-language subscription comparison and renewal-planning resource. Browse public guides and source-linked information about AI subscription plans, and organize renewal details. Prices, eligibility and cancellation terms can change; confirm them with the original provider. Listed third-party subscriptions may be paid.
AILearnHub takes articles, ideas, and questions and organizes them into structured lessons for teaching or personal study.

Social network for AI agents, settled in Nano (XNO). Agents post what they are stuck on, answer each other, mark the answer that worked and pay for it in Nano. Instant, feeless, no account, no identity check: an agent can ask, answer and settle without a bank or a card.

AI employees for small teams: delegate support investigations, sales research, content and recurring work with connected tools, permissions and approval rules. Online AI image text editor that replaces existing words in finished PNG/JPG/WebP images and tries to match the original font, color, and background. Results vary by image.

Free appointment scheduling with shareable booking pages and an owner-authenticated REST API for finding availability, creating and verifying bookings, and cancellation. Currently in beta; Google calendar OAuth verification is ongoing.

Its intelligent AI agents identify SEO issues, uncover keyword opportunities, optimize website content, and automate repetitive SEO tasks. SourceSEO.ai is designed for SEO professionals, digital marketing agencies, SaaS companies, startups, e-commerce businesses, and enterprises seeking to streamline SEO workflows, strengthen online visibility, and achieve long-term organic growth.

CheckAIVisibility is a free AI visibility checker. Enter your website and it asks AI models the buyer-style questions your customers ask, then shows whether your brand is mentioned, where it appears in the list, which competitors are named instead, and which third-party pages the answers cite, with one suggested action for each cited page.

The free check runs 5 questions on OpenAI with web search and adds on-site AI readiness checks: robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, llms.txt, JSON-LD, meta tags, server-rendered text and sitemap. It is limited to 3 free checks per day per network. No account is needed.

The full report is a one-time $9: 15 questions across OpenAI and Claude with web search plus Gemini from model knowledge, 2 runs each (90 answers), per-engine scores and one re-check after 30 days. No subscription.

Results come from the official APIs and can differ from the ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini apps. CheckAIVisibility is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. It is a one-time audit, not ongoing monitoring.

SkillSoniq is an AI-powered hiring app that lets companies test-drive talent on real, paid work before committing to full-time payroll. Employers post jobs for free and get AI-matched candidates within seconds, then either hire onto payroll from day one or start a paid project and convert when ready. SkillSoniq runs background checks, handles onboarding paperwork and weekly timesheets, and sends one consolidated invoice. Pricing: free to post and hire; a payment-processing fee plus up to 20% commission on paid trial work; a buyout fee on payroll conversion. Web and iOS.

Hailbell is in-app support chat plus push notifications for iOS, Android and web apps.

Customers write from inside your app. An AI answers first from your docs and real prices, and you finish the reply from the dashboard, a Discord thread, Telegram or an AI agent over MCP. The customer gets a push when you answer.

Each conversation shows the customer's plan, purchases, device and country. Hailbell can show an offer card that opens your paywall, and ask for an App Store review right after a problem is solved.

Push campaigns go to iOS, Android and web in one send, with segments, each person's local time, quiet hours and daily caps.

Native Swift and Kotlin SDKs and a web widget. Unlimited apps and seats. From $29/month, free for 14 days, no card required.

PhotoCraft AI combines a free browser-based photo and PSD editor with optional AI tools. Edit layers, masks, text and adjustments manually, or ask an AI Agent to make supported changes to your open document. Generate images from prompts or references with a choice of AI models.

EasyRunCraft is a professional online office and creative suite built for people and AI agents. It brings 13 free browser editors together — WordCraft, GridCraft, DeckCraft, PdfCraft, PhotoCraft, LightCraft, VectorCraft, FigCraft, DesignCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft, SoundCraft and CADCraft — covering documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, images, design, video, audio and 2D CAD.

Edit, save and export manually in the browser for free, with no account required. Sign in to use the built-in AI agent for in-editor changes, or connect your own agent (Codex, Claude Code and compatible MCP clients) so it can inspect and edit supported files and return results. One account and one shared credit balance work across all editors; new accounts receive starter credits. Manual editing stays free; AI and MCP processing use credits.

Glide is an AI agent that takes on the legwork of your job search: finding roles worth your time, researching each company and drafting applications written for the person who will read them. You approve everything. Currently invite-only - join the waitlist on the site.
OpenLegion is an AI agent platform for SaaS: secure agents call your functions, with a workspace per customer, approvals, spending caps and receipts.

Peeve is an AI customer support agent for SaaS teams. It answers questions from your docs, shows users where to click inside your product, takes actions like resetting a password or changing a plan, and hands off to your team when a human is needed. It works in your in-app widget and over email, and remembers each customer across conversations. Pricing is credit-based, with plans from $40/month and a 14-day free trial.

NGIN360 is an AI agent team for business work. You describe an outcome, it writes a plan you can approve, hands each step to a specialist agent (development, marketing, research, design) and checks each result against stated criteria. It stops for a person before anything consequential, such as sending or publishing, and runs scheduled and event-triggered work across connected apps like Gmail, Google Calendar and GitHub. It is for people running a business or a small team who want agents to do the work while people keep the decisions. Free during early access.

TinyCommand is an all-in-one no-code automation platform for founders, operators and business teams. It connects forms, visual workflows, data tables, AI agents and email tools so teams can collect information, manage data and automate follow-up in one place. Forms can look up data and branch while people fill them in, and workflows connect business apps. TinyCommand offers a free plan and paid plans. AI agent steps run on every plan; building custom agents starts on Professional. TinySEO and TinyAnswers are paid tools with a seven-day trial on Free.

REA.ai is an AI-powered real estate business phone system designed for agents, brokers, and real estate teams. It answers incoming property calls 24/7, responds to listing questions, captures buyer and renter leads, and helps schedule property showings.

With dedicated listing phone numbers and a built-in CRM, REA.ai helps agents organize inquiries, manage contacts, and follow up with potential clients.

Whether you're showing homes, meeting clients, or working after hours, REA.ai helps ensure valuable property inquiries don't go unanswered.

TheRouter is an OpenAI-compatible API gateway. Point a client such as Cursor or Claude Code at one endpoint to reach models from multiple providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and DeepSeek. It adds automatic failover, real-time token and cost tracking per API key, spending limits, and bring-your-own-keys. Pricing: https://therouter.ai/pricing/. Quickstart: https://therouter.ai/docs/quickstart/.

Campfire SMS gives your AI agent a phone line to you. When a long-running agent needs an answer, you get a real text and your plain-language reply goes back to the agent. Works over MCP. Free demo, then pay-as-you-go credit packs from $5.

Independent Development and Modular Architecture
Development began on June 16, 2026, as an independent project founded in Latvia.
AIIIA Castle is developed using an AI-assisted engineering workflow and a modular architecture that brings together conversational AI, backend services, persistent account data, user authentication, and interactive web interfaces.
The project focuses on combining technologies that are often presented separately: AI companions (Characters from Warm till Femdom role-play), gamification, digital art, personal activity tools, and community participation.
This modular approach is intended to support continued development and the introduction of additional AI capabilities without requiring a complete redesign of the ecosystem.
Our Vision
Artificial intelligence is becoming increasingly accessible, but many AI products still focus on individual conversations or isolated productivity tasks.
AIIIA Castle explores a different direction: an interactive environment in which AI companionship, creativity, and community participation become parts of one connected experience.
Our goal is to build a recognizable digital destination where users can interact with distinct AI personalities, earn participation rewards, discover independent artists, and contribute to an evolving community.
The project is currently growing through its Telegram-based platform, continued product development, and early community participation.
AIIIA Castle welcomes beta testers, artists, early adopters, and potential collaborators who are interested in helping shape the next stage of this AI-powered ecosystem.

FreakLabs is a hands-on AI security training platform built by KageX, an offensive AI security startup based in Noida, India. It was created for people who want to learn how AI systems actually get attacked, not just read about it. Instead of slides and multiple-choice quizzes, FreakLabs drops you into live attack labs where you work against real large language models, AI agents and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems running in private sandboxes.

Today the platform includes 20 attack labs and a 9-level curriculum with 54 lessons. The labs cover the attacks that matter most for teams shipping AI products: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, insecure tool use by agents, poisoned retrieval content and other weaknesses that appear when language models are connected to data, tools and users. Each lab gives you an isolated environment, so you can experiment freely without touching anyone else's systems and without breaking anything that matters.
